Lina (partnerships): Quick sync: were trying to codify how SI claims, how marketplace private offers tie to HW bundles, and a simple conflict resolution for overlapping accounts. Can we align?
Marcus (sales): Need to avoid "stomp" situations. Sales wants a primary owner tag and a soft-claim window so AE can still chase if SI is unresponsive.
Priya (solutions): Proposal: 36h soft-claim for discovery + 72h exclusive if SI requests demo slot (they must set pre-demo flag). Demo flag prevents AE outreach except for escalation.
Carlos (marketplace): For private marketplace offers we need partner_sku and marketplace_offer_id linked. If HW partner is in the bundle, marketplace must reflect hw_partner_id for billing reconciliation.
Nina (legal): Legal asks that any joint announcement include partner logo usage rights and a 5-business-day signoff. We'll keep a standard Partner Announcement Addendum.
Lina (partnerships): New intake fields suggested: claimed_until, pre_demo_flag, partner_sku, marketplace_offer_id, source_region. Example webhook payload below:
```json
{
  "lead_id": "L-2024-9988",
  "account_name": "Acme Corp",
  "source": "si-webhook",
  "partner_sku": "HPE-AI-STACK-1",
  "marketplace_offer_id": "aws-private-0123",
  "pre_demo_flag": true,
  "claimed_by": "partner:alpha-solutions",
  "claimed_until": "2024-05-30T18:30:00Z",
  "source_region": "EMEA"
}
```
Priya (solutions): Also recommend automatic owner resolution: if two parties try to claim, highest-priority = explicit pre_demo_flag > first-claim timestamp > partner tier (platinum > gold). We'll surface conflict email to both owners + partnerships.
Marcus (sales): FYI: deals originating in marketplace should still credit RDW AE if marked in SFDC. Need a canonical attribution field or mapping rule.
Carlos (marketplace): We'll add marketplace_origin and origin_attribution fields in the export. ETA 4 business days.
Nina (legal): Reminder that marketplace private offers may require separate data processing addendum if customer data crosses partner boundaries.
eng-bot: Note: intake schema updated: new fields added: pre_demo_flag, claimed_until, marketplace_offer_id. See https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-intake-schema for details.
Lina (partnerships): Action list: Priya to draft claim priority logic, Carlos to map marketplace -> hw partner ids, Marcus to propose attribution fields for SFDC, Nina to prepare announcement addendum template. I'll put a single-page playbook up and coordinate a 20-min follow-up on Thu 10am PT.
Marcus (sales): Good plan. Can we include a $300k+ auto-escalation to CRO + Partnerships for joint discount sign-off?
Priya (solutions): Yes, add escalation threshold config in the playbook. Also logging: store claim events in a small audit table for 90 days.
Lina (partnerships): Thanks all 0 9f 91 8c. I'll post playbook link once live.
